description:
Port 4 foundational example extensions that exercise the core API:
- hello.ts → Hello: basic tool registration via registerTool
- commands.ts → Commands: registerCommand with handler(args, ctx), branch entry access
- event-bus.ts → EventBus: pi.events.on/emit for inter-extension communication
- session-name.ts → SessionName: session metadata access

Each extension gets a test file exercising init + handler behaviour. These are the simplest — if they don't work cleanly, the API surface has fundamental gaps.
title: Example extensions wave 1: basic API surface (hello, commands, event-bus, session-name)
